acceptance_evidence: CCA verdict and MergeGate evidence are recorded before completion.
completion_conditions: A Guardian comment that refuses or revokes approval can never satisfy the gate, and a removed guardian label cannot be replayed by another actor.
A rename cannot move a file out of locked scope unseen, and no PR can modify or delete another goal's mirror records.
A CCA verdict of complete that itself marks an acceptance criterion failed, or sets can_merge false, is refused by both the verdict enforcer and MergeGate.
A dispatched repair reaches the PR head; a failed push stops the loop instead of silently burning a repair attempt.
A multi-task goal is never marked complete on main after only its first task merges, and goal_complete never reverts an unrelated goal's in-flight state.
The MergeGate metadata job passes the flags its own mode requires, orchestrator evidence is actually committed, and no GitHub expression is interpolated into a run: body.
A retried shiki start re-attempts every GitHub governance step, an existing branch is never force-reset, and doctor reports an unprotected branch as a failure.
Migrations apply in a target repository and fail with the [shiki] error contract.
Every mirror record validates against the schema shipped beside it, enforced in CI.

decisions: Concurrency is not the constraint: every Shiki task locks path:.shiki/** and try_acquire_locks refuses on overlap, so at most one task is in flight repo-wide. The plan is a single lane; ordering, not parallelism, is the design question.

Cross-goal ordering (hard): R-01 before ADR0015-T5; ADR0015-T1 before R-02 before ADR0015-T5; R-02 before R-03 (the CCA verdict schema file is unmergeable until runtime_evidence_path is fixed); R-05 before ADR0015-T6; R-04 before ADR0015-T3 and T6; R-09 last.

One fold is recommended into ADR 0015 rather than planned here: guardian-policy.json is read from the PR head, so a PR can name its own author a Guardian and self-approve. ADR0015-T4 already locks both mergegate_check.py and guardian-policy.json, and its acceptance check 5 is unsatisfiable without this fix. Folding it requires a second Spec Amendment to the ADR 0015 plan.

R-07 is recommended to be pulled forward: a target repo can run Shiki with no server-side enforcement at all, which makes every ADR 0015 gate decorative in targets. It has zero effect on this platform repo.

Surfaces where nothing survived, recorded so the absence is evidence: runner auth and secret handling, the external AI Guardian review path (ADR 0010/0014), the memory subsystem, and goal_reconcile's own validator (probed repeatedly as a bypass and held every time).
grill_with_docs.source: Repo-wide adversarial audit 2026-07-25 (Workflow we1mhqcd4, 43 agents: 8 surface finders -> independent refuters on every blocking/important finding -> 1 synthesizer). 27 findings survived; 20 are non-minor.

non_goals: The six defects owned by ADR 0015 goal G-20260725T112636727659Z-23ba3b56 (contract mutability, head-resolved risk/locks, the dispatch gate, the needs: cca dependency, the multi-task contract path, test_command freezing).
Replacing GITHUB_TOKEN for the orchestrator evidence PR — that creates a long-lived credential and is a Guardian decision.
Reconciling live branch protection with .shiki/config.yaml — an operator action on GitHub, not code.
Judging CCA checklist quality; the profile-coverage check detects a non-evaluating CCA, not a lazy one.
Changing the id generator or migrating existing record ids.
outcome: The 20 non-minor defects that survived independent refutation in the repo-wide adversarial audit are closed, without weakening the in-flight ADR 0015 contract-approval work: Guardian approval evidence becomes current and revocable, MergeGate scope enforcement sees renames and the whole mirror, a self-contradictory CCA verdict is refused, repairs actually reach the PR, closeout stops completing goals early and clobbering sibling state, workflows invoke what they claim to, bootstrap never destroys a target or skips its governance setup, migrations apply in targets, and the shipped schemas match the ids Shiki generates.
title: Close the surviving adversarial-audit findings
